script.problem: It has 41 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.
It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: The two explanations sound like they go together, rather than like different interpretations. Say simply that one explanation is focusing on pleasing God, while another is being generous.
“Inner eye” and “your whole life will be bright” may be hard for a 10-year-old to understand. Use plainer words to explain that focusing on pleasing God guides how a person lives.
